name: What should I look for in a commercial plumbing contractor for TIs?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a commercial plumbing contractor for TIs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a commercial plumbing contractor for tenant improvements, look for experience with similar commercial projects, proper licensing and insurance, and a strong understanding of local building codes in your area, such as Goodyear or Avondale. A good contractor should offer clear communication, provide detailed estimates, and have a reputation for reliability and quality workmanship. Ask for references and examples of past tenant improvement projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience with commercial projects, proper licensing, local code knowledge, clear communication, detailed estimates, and good references.
